name: – Niclas Herbst – After § 18 – Am 43
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 18c. Notes with concern that the Court, in its Special Report 11/2025, found that approximately €7.4 billion of EU public funds were allocated to around 12,000 NGO with a disproportionate share granted to just 30 NGOs; requests, therefore, to proceed with the immediate full disclosure of all contracts signed with NGOs receiving Union funds in the interest of full transparency, accountability, and public trust;
